test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown (Figures 1 - 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face having ‘6’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6834d8e2639a8698dafc257404214a46cd27aba2b8773e21216aaa0653711796.png]
solution:
When we compare figure 1 and figure 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96b743b6840223ee8f7c4c2a5e6e7dd2fcc366530bd741cb2c0c4985c5e8a219.png] We can see that 3 is opposite to 4.

When we compare figure 1 and figure 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f129d8ead5722928110e1a57159a06e4a2057e65113ef3e2f62e24bc00098078.png] We can see that 2 is opposite to 5.

Now we only have two faces left i.e., 1 and 6 which means 1 and 6 are opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.
